parameters.query:
INSERT INTO reconciliation_runs (
  business_date, timezone, payments_checked, enrolments_checked,
  missing_enrolment_count, orphan_enrolment_count, details
)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (business_date) DO UPDATE
  SET timezone = EXCLUDED.timezone,
      payments_checked = EXCLUDED.payments_checked,
      enrolments_checked = EXCLUDED.enrolments_checked,
      missing_enrolment_count = EXCLUDED.missing_enrolment_count,
      orphan_enrolment_count = EXCLUDED.orphan_enrolment_count,
      details = EXCLUDED.details,
      ran_at = now()
RETURNING id, business_date;
